units.source_text: ……不妨回忆一下，后来父亲出殡，我虽急于要看看父亲的遗容，却没有流一滴眼泪。

en.t: ... It is worth recalling that later, when my father was taken out for burial, although I was eager to see his face in death, I did not shed a single tear.

units.source_text: 不妨回忆一下，手掌的羁绊，与父亲的死一起被解开，我通过只顾着父亲的遗容确认了自己的生。

en.t: It is worth recalling that the bond of the palm was released together with my father's death, and by concentrating only on my father's face in death, I confirmed my own life.

units.source_text: 对于这手掌，这人世间称为爱情的东西，我如此忘不了要忠实地复仇，

en.t: Toward this palm, toward the thing people in this world call love, I was so unable to forget that I had to take faithful revenge,

units.source_text: 而对于母亲则有别于那不可饶恕的记忆，我是从未曾想过要复仇。

en.t: but toward my mother, apart from that unforgivable memory, I had never once thought of taking revenge.
